title: 成年人需要：麻疹加强针吗？，专家绝大多数不需要
speaker: Dr. Amish Adolgez

segments.en: The vast vast majority of people, the standard two-dose childhood vaccination schedule will protect them for life.
segments.zh: 绝大多数人，标准的两剂儿童疫苗接种方案可提供终身保护。

segments.en: That doesn't mean that the vaccine is 100%, but it's pushing above 95%. So there's no generalized recommendation for boosters that are needed for the population.
segments.zh: 疫苗并非100%有效，但有效率超过95%，因此没有普遍推荐人群接种加强针。

segments.en: It's really about people who've had zero doses of measles. That's what's driving this.
segments.zh: 真正的问题在于从未接种过麻疹疫苗的人群，这才是疫情驱动的根源。
